title: French culture
standfirst: The facts behind the culture quiz — starting with la bise.
summary: Sixteen facts worth knowing, and a quiz that shuffles them.
facts: French people greet each other with la bise — kisses on the cheeks.
The flag is blue, white and red.
About 69 million people live in France.
France is the most visited country in the world.
The Eiffel Tower was built for the 1889 World's Fair in Paris.
The Mona Lisa hangs in the Louvre, in Paris.
Renault and Peugeot are French car makes.
Louis Pasteur, who gave his name to pasteurised milk, was French.
Le Tour de France is a cycling race.
The Pyrenees are the mountains between France and Spain.
Zidane, Mbappé and Dembélé are French footballers.
French is an official language in 29 countries.
France makes over 10 billion baguettes a year.
France's neighbours are Belgium, Luxembourg, Germany, Switzerland, Italy and Spain — and Monaco and Andorra.
Corsica is a French island in the Mediterranean.

notes.lead: La bise is the one to be sure of
notes.body: The teacher pointed at this one. The rest of the page is worth knowing; that one was named.

notes.lead: Where the class notes and the quiz differ
notes.body: The Mona Lisa is sometimes said to have been painted in France. Leonardo began it in Italy and brought it with him, so the safe answer is that it hangs in the Louvre.
